title: Put these events in order: The Journey of Abraham
hint: The first event is in Genesis 12.

events_in_stated_order.event: God calls Abram to leave his country
events_in_stated_order.kjv: Now the LORD had said unto Abram, Get thee out of thy country, and from thy kindred, and from thy father’s house, unto a land that I will shew thee:

events_in_stated_order.event: God promises descendants like the stars
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And he brought him forth abroad, and said, Look now toward heaven, and tell the stars, if thou be able to number them: and he said unto him, So shall thy seed be.

events_in_stated_order.event: Abram's name is changed to Abraham
events_in_stated_order.kjv: Neither shall thy name any more be called Abram, but thy name shall be Abraham; for a father of many nations have I made thee.

events_in_stated_order.event: Isaac is born to Sarah
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And Abraham called the name of his son that was born unto him, whom Sarah bare to him, Isaac.

events_in_stated_order.event: Abraham is tested in the land of Moriah
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And he said, Take now thy son, thine only son Isaac, whom thou lovest, and get thee into the land of Moriah; and offer him there for a burnt offering upon one of the mountains which I will tell thee of.

title: Put these events in order: The Early Church
hint: The first event is in Acts 1.

events_in_stated_order.event: Jesus is taken up in a cloud
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And when he had spoken these things, while they beheld, he was taken up; and a cloud received him out of their sight.

events_in_stated_order.event: The Spirit comes at Pentecost
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And when the day of Pentecost was fully come, they were all with one accord in one place. And suddenly there came a sound from heaven as of a rushing mighty wind, and it filled all the house where they were sitting. And there appeared unto them cloven tongues like as of fire, and it sat upon each of them. And they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and began to speak with other tongues, as the Spirit gave them utterance.

events_in_stated_order.event: A lame man is healed at the temple gate
events_in_stated_order.kjv: Then Peter said, Silver and gold have I none; but such as I have give I thee: In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth rise up and walk. And he took him by the right hand, and lifted him up: and immediately his feet and ankle bones received strength. And he leaping up stood, and walked, and entered with them into the temple, walking, and leaping, and praising God.

events_in_stated_order.event: Stephen is stoned
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And they stoned Stephen, calling upon God, and saying, Lord Jesus, receive my spirit.

events_in_stated_order.event: Saul meets the risen Jesus near Damascus
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And as he journeyed, he came near Damascus: and suddenly there shined round about him a light from heaven: And he fell to the earth, and heard a voice saying unto him, Saul, Saul, why persecutest thou me?

title: Put these events in order: The Days of Creation
hint: The first event is in Genesis 1.

events_in_stated_order.event: Light is divided from darkness
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And God said, Let there be light: and there was light. And God saw the light, that it was good: and God divided the light from the darkness. And God called the light Day, and the darkness he called Night. And the evening and the morning were the first day.

events_in_stated_order.event: The firmament divides the waters
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And God said, Let there be a firmament in the midst of the waters, and let it divide the waters from the waters. And God made the firmament, and divided the waters which were under the firmament from the waters which were above the firmament: and it was so. And God called the firmament Heaven. And the evening and the morning were the second day.

events_in_stated_order.event: Dry land appears and plants grow
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And God said, Let the waters under the heaven be gathered together unto one place, and let the dry land appear: and it was so. And God called the dry land Earth; and the gathering together of the waters called he Seas: and God saw that it was good. And God said, Let the earth bring forth grass, the herb yielding seed, and the fruit tree yielding fruit after his kind, whose seed is in itself, upon the earth: and it was so. And the earth brought forth grass, and herb yielding seed after his kind, and the tree yielding fruit, whose seed was in itself, after his kind: and God saw that it was good. And the evening and the morning were the third day.

events_in_stated_order.event: The sun, moon and stars are set in the sky
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And God said, Let there be lights in the firmament of the heaven to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days, and years: And let them be for lights in the firmament of the heaven to give light upon the earth: and it was so. And God made two great lights; the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night: he made the stars also. And God set them in the firmament of the heaven to give light upon the earth, And to rule over the day and over the night, and to divide the light from the darkness: and God saw that it was good. And the evening and the morning were the fourth day.

events_in_stated_order.event: Sea creatures and birds are created
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And God said, Let the waters bring forth abundantly the moving creature that hath life, and fowl that may fly above the earth in the open firmament of heaven. And God created great whales, and every living creature that moveth, which the waters brought forth abundantly, after their kind, and every winged fowl after his kind: and God saw that it was good. And God blessed them, saying, Be fruitful, and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and let fowl multiply in the earth. And the evening and the morning were the fifth day.

title: Put these events in order: Daniel in Babylon
hint: The first event is in Daniel 1.

events_in_stated_order.event: Daniel refuses the king's meat
events_in_stated_order.kjv: But Daniel purposed in his heart that he would not defile himself with the portion of the king’s meat, nor with the wine which he drank: therefore he requested of the prince of the eunuchs that he might not defile himself.

events_in_stated_order.event: Daniel interprets the dream of the great image
events_in_stated_order.kjv: Thou, O king, sawest, and behold a great image. This great image, whose brightness was excellent, stood before thee; and the form thereof was terrible.

events_in_stated_order.event: Three friends are cast into the furnace
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And these three men, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, fell down bound into the midst of the burning fiery furnace.

events_in_stated_order.event: Fingers write on the palace wall
events_in_stated_order.kjv: In the same hour came forth fingers of a man’s hand, and wrote over against the candlestick upon the plaister of the wall of the king’s palace: and the king saw the part of the hand that wrote.

events_in_stated_order.event: Daniel is cast into the den of lions
events_in_stated_order.kjv: Then the king commanded, and they brought Daniel, and cast him into the den of lions. Now the king spake and said unto Daniel, Thy God whom thou servest continually, he will deliver thee.

title: Put these events in order: David's Path to the Throne
hint: The first event is in 1 Samuel 16.

events_in_stated_order.event: Samuel anoints David
events_in_stated_order.kjv: Then Samuel took the horn of oil, and anointed him in the midst of his brethren: and the Spirit of the LORD came upon David from that day forward. So Samuel rose up, and went to Ramah.

events_in_stated_order.event: David plays the harp for Saul
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And it came to pass, when the evil spirit from God was upon Saul, that David took an harp, and played with his hand: so Saul was refreshed, and was well, and the evil spirit departed from him.

events_in_stated_order.event: David defeats Goliath
events_in_stated_order.kjv: So David prevailed over the Philistine with a sling and with a stone, and smote the Philistine, and slew him; but there was no sword in the hand of David.

events_in_stated_order.event: David spares Saul in the cave
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And the men of David said unto him, Behold the day of which the LORD said unto thee, Behold, I will deliver thine enemy into thine hand, that thou mayest do to him as it shall seem good unto thee. Then David arose, and cut off the skirt of Saul’s robe privily.

events_in_stated_order.event: David is anointed king over Israel
events_in_stated_order.kjv: So all the elders of Israel came to the king to Hebron; and king David made a league with them in Hebron before the LORD: and they anointed David king over Israel.

title: Put these events in order: Elijah the Prophet
hint: The first event is in 1 Kings 17.

events_in_stated_order.event: Ravens feed Elijah
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And the ravens brought him bread and flesh in the morning, and bread and flesh in the evening; and he drank of the brook.

events_in_stated_order.event: The widow's meal and oil do not run out
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And the barrel of meal wasted not, neither did the cruse of oil fail, according to the word of the LORD, which he spake by Elijah.

events_in_stated_order.event: Fire falls on Mount Carmel
events_in_stated_order.kjv: Then the fire of the LORD fell, and consumed the burnt sacrifice, and the wood, and the stones, and the dust, and licked up the water that was in the trench.

events_in_stated_order.event: Elijah hears a still small voice
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And after the earthquake a fire; but the LORD was not in the fire: and after the fire a still small voice.

events_in_stated_order.event: Elijah goes up by a whirlwind
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And it came to pass, as they still went on, and talked, that, behold, there appeared a chariot of fire, and horses of fire, and parted them both asunder; and Elijah went up by a whirlwind into heaven.

title: Put these events in order: Esther Saves Her People
hint: The first event is in Esther 2.

events_in_stated_order.event: Esther is made queen
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And the king loved Esther above all the women, and she obtained grace and favour in his sight more than all the virgins; so that he set the royal crown upon her head, and made her queen instead of Vashti.

events_in_stated_order.event: Haman plots against the Jews
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And he thought scorn to lay hands on Mordecai alone; for they had shewed him the people of Mordecai: wherefore Haman sought to destroy all the Jews that were throughout the whole kingdom of Ahasuerus, even the people of Mordecai.

events_in_stated_order.event: Esther goes in to the king
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And it was so, when the king saw Esther the queen standing in the court, that she obtained favour in his sight: and the king held out to Esther the golden sceptre that was in his hand. So Esther drew near, and touched the top of the sceptre.

events_in_stated_order.event: Haman is hanged on his own gallows
events_in_stated_order.kjv: So they hanged Haman on the gallows that he had prepared for Mordecai. Then was the king’s wrath pacified.

title: Put these events in order: Out of Egypt
hint: The first event is in Exodus 2.

events_in_stated_order.event: Baby Moses is placed among the bulrushes
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And when she could not longer hide him, she took for him an ark of bulrushes, and daubed it with slime and with pitch, and put the child therein; and she laid it in the flags by the river’s brink.

events_in_stated_order.event: God speaks from the burning bush
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And the angel of the LORD appeared unto him in a flame of fire out of the midst of a bush: and he looked, and, behold, the bush burned with fire, and the bush was not consumed.

events_in_stated_order.event: The river is turned to blood
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And Moses and Aaron did so, as the LORD commanded; and he lifted up the rod, and smote the waters that were in the river, in the sight of Pharaoh, and in the sight of his servants; and all the waters that were in the river were turned to blood.

events_in_stated_order.event: The first Passover is kept
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And the blood shall be to you for a token upon the houses where ye are: and when I see the blood, I will pass over you, and the plague shall not be upon you to destroy you, when I smite the land of Egypt.

events_in_stated_order.event: Israel crosses the Red Sea on dry ground
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And the children of Israel went into the midst of the sea upon the dry ground: and the waters were a wall unto them on their right hand, and on their left.

title: Put these events in order: Gideon's Three Hundred
hint: The first event is in Judges 6.

events_in_stated_order.event: An angel appears to Gideon by the winepress
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And there came an angel of the LORD, and sat under an oak which was in Ophrah, that pertained unto Joash the Abi-ezrite: and his son Gideon threshed wheat by the winepress, to hide it from the Midianites. And the angel of the LORD appeared unto him, and said unto him, The LORD is with thee, thou mighty man of valour.

events_in_stated_order.event: Gideon tests God with a fleece
events_in_stated_order.kjv: Behold, I will put a fleece of wool in the floor; and if the dew be on the fleece only, and it be dry upon all the earth beside, then shall I know that thou wilt save Israel by mine hand, as thou hast said.

events_in_stated_order.event: God reduces the army to three hundred
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And the LORD said unto Gideon, By the three hundred men that lapped will I save you, and deliver the Midianites into thine hand: and let all the other people go every man unto his place.

events_in_stated_order.event: Trumpets sound and pitchers are broken
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And the three companies blew the trumpets, and brake the pitchers, and held the lamps in their left hands, and the trumpets in their right hands to blow withal: and they cried, The sword of the LORD, and of Gideon.

title: Put these events in order: The Life of Jacob
hint: The first event is in Genesis 25.

events_in_stated_order.event: Jacob is born holding Esau's heel
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And after that came his brother out, and his hand took hold on Esau’s heel; and his name was called Jacob: and Isaac was threescore years old when she bare them.

events_in_stated_order.event: Esau sells his birthright for pottage
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And Jacob said, Swear to me this day; and he sware unto him: and he sold his birthright unto Jacob. Then Jacob gave Esau bread and pottage of lentiles; and he did eat and drink, and rose up, and went his way: thus Esau despised his birthright.

events_in_stated_order.event: Jacob dreams of a ladder to heaven
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And he dreamed, and behold a ladder set up on the earth, and the top of it reached to heaven: and behold the angels of God ascending and descending on it.

events_in_stated_order.event: Jacob wrestles and is renamed Israel
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And he said, Thy name shall be called no more Jacob, but Israel: for as a prince hast thou power with God and with men, and hast prevailed.

title: Put these events in order: Jonah and Nineveh
hint: The first event is in Jonah 1.

events_in_stated_order.event: God calls Jonah to go to Nineveh
events_in_stated_order.kjv: Arise, go to Nineveh, that great city, and cry against it; for their wickedness is come up before me.

events_in_stated_order.event: Jonah flees toward Tarshish
events_in_stated_order.kjv: But Jonah rose up to flee unto Tarshish from the presence of the LORD, and went down to Joppa; and he found a ship going to Tarshish: so he paid the fare thereof, and went down into it, to go with them unto Tarshish from the presence of the LORD.

events_in_stated_order.event: A great fish swallows Jonah
events_in_stated_order.kjv: Now the LORD had prepared a great fish to swallow up Jonah. And Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights.

events_in_stated_order.event: Jonah warns Nineveh: forty days
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And Jonah began to enter into the city a day’s journey, and he cried, and said, Yet forty days, and Nineveh shall be overthrown.

events_in_stated_order.event: God prepares a gourd to shade Jonah
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And the LORD God prepared a gourd, and made it to come up over Jonah, that it might be a shadow over his head, to deliver him from his grief. So Jonah was exceeding glad of the gourd.

title: Put these events in order: Joseph's Rise in Egypt
hint: The first event is in Genesis 37.

events_in_stated_order.event: Jacob gives Joseph a coat of many colours
events_in_stated_order.kjv: Now Israel loved Joseph more than all his children, because he was the son of his old age: and he made him a coat of many colours.

events_in_stated_order.event: Joseph's brothers sell him for twenty pieces of silver
events_in_stated_order.kjv: Then there passed by Midianites merchantmen; and they drew and lifted up Joseph out of the pit, and sold Joseph to the Ishmeelites for twenty pieces of silver: and they brought Joseph into Egypt.

events_in_stated_order.event: Joseph serves in Potiphar's house
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And Joseph was brought down to Egypt; and Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh, captain of the guard, an Egyptian, bought him of the hands of the Ishmeelites, which had brought him down thither.

events_in_stated_order.event: Joseph interprets Pharaoh's dream
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And Joseph said unto Pharaoh, The dream of Pharaoh is one: God hath shewed Pharaoh what he is about to do.

events_in_stated_order.event: Joseph reveals himself to his brothers
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And Joseph said unto his brethren, Come near to me, I pray you. And they came near. And he said, I am Joseph your brother, whom ye sold into Egypt.

title: Put these events in order: Into the Promised Land
hint: The first event is in Joshua 2.

events_in_stated_order.event: Rahab hides the spies in Jericho
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And Joshua the son of Nun sent out of Shittim two men to spy secretly, saying, Go view the land, even Jericho. And they went, and came into an harlot’s house, named Rahab, and lodged there. And it was told the king of Jericho, saying, Behold, there came men in hither to night of the children of Israel to search out the country. And the king of Jericho sent unto Rahab, saying, Bring forth the men that are come to thee, which are entered into thine house: for they be come to search out all the country. And the woman took the two men, and hid them, and said thus, There came men unto me, but I wist not whence they were:

events_in_stated_order.event: Israel crosses the Jordan on dry ground
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And the priests that bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD stood firm on dry ground in the midst of Jordan, and all the Israelites passed over on dry ground, until all the people were passed clean over Jordan.

events_in_stated_order.event: The walls of Jericho fall
events_in_stated_order.kjv: So the people shouted when the priests blew with the trumpets: and it came to pass, when the people heard the sound of the trumpet, and the people shouted with a great shout, that the wall fell down flat, so that the people went up into the city, every man straight before him, and they took the city.

events_in_stated_order.event: The sun stands still at Gibeon
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And the sun stood still, and the moon stayed, until the people had avenged themselves upon their enemies. Is not this written in the book of Jasher? So the sun stood still in the midst of heaven, and hasted not to go down about a whole day.

title: Put these events in order: Jesus Begins His Ministry
hint: The first event is in Matthew 3.

events_in_stated_order.event: Jesus is baptized
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And Jesus, when he was baptized, went up straightway out of the water: and, lo, the heavens were opened unto him, and he saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove, and lighting upon him:

events_in_stated_order.event: Jesus is tempted in the wilderness
events_in_stated_order.kjv: Then was Jesus led up of the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted of the devil.

events_in_stated_order.event: Jesus calls fishermen to be fishers of men
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And he saith unto them, Follow me, and I will make you fishers of men.

events_in_stated_order.event: Jesus teaches on the mountain
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And seeing the multitudes, he went up into a mountain: and when he was set, his disciples came unto him:

title: Put these events in order: The Birth of Jesus
hint: The first event is in Luke 1.

events_in_stated_order.event: Gabriel announces Jesus' birth to Mary
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And, behold, thou shalt conceive in thy womb, and bring forth a son, and shalt call his name JESUS.

events_in_stated_order.event: Joseph and Mary travel to Bethlehem
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And Joseph also went up from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth, into Judæa, unto the city of David, which is called Bethlehem; (because he was of the house and lineage of David:)

events_in_stated_order.event: Angels appear to shepherds
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And there were in the same country shepherds abiding in the field, keeping watch over their flock by night. And, lo, the angel of the Lord came upon them, and the glory of the Lord shone round about them: and they were sore afraid.

events_in_stated_order.event: Simeon holds the child in the temple
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And, behold, there was a man in Jerusalem, whose name was Simeon; and the same man was just and devout, waiting for the consolation of Israel: and the Holy Ghost was upon him. And it was revealed unto him by the Holy Ghost, that he should not see death, before he had seen the Lord’s Christ. And he came by the Spirit into the temple: and when the parents brought in the child Jesus, to do for him after the custom of the law, Then took he him up in his arms, and blessed God, and said,

events_in_stated_order.event: The twelve-year-old Jesus is found in the temple
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And when he was twelve years old, they went up to Jerusalem after the custom of the feast. And when they had fulfilled the days, as they returned, the child Jesus tarried behind in Jerusalem; and Joseph and his mother knew not of it. But they, supposing him to have been in the company, went a day’s journey; and they sought him among their kinsfolk and acquaintance. And when they found him not, they turned back again to Jerusalem, seeking him. And it came to pass, that after three days they found him in the temple, sitting in the midst of the doctors, both hearing them, and asking them questions.

title: Put these events in order: Noah and the Flood
hint: The first event is in Genesis 6.

events_in_stated_order.event: God tells Noah to build an ark of gopher wood
events_in_stated_order.kjv: Make thee an ark of gopher wood; rooms shalt thou make in the ark, and shalt pitch it within and without with pitch.

events_in_stated_order.event: Noah's family and the animals go into the ark
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And Noah went in, and his sons, and his wife, and his sons’ wives with him, into the ark, because of the waters of the flood. Of clean beasts, and of beasts that are not clean, and of fowls, and of every thing that creepeth upon the earth, There went in two and two unto Noah into the ark, the male and the female, as God had commanded Noah.

events_in_stated_order.event: Rain falls for forty days and forty nights
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And the rain was upon the earth forty days and forty nights.

events_in_stated_order.event: A dove returns with an olive leaf
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And the dove came in to him in the evening; and, lo, in her mouth was an olive leaf pluckt off: so Noah knew that the waters were abated from off the earth.

events_in_stated_order.event: God sets His bow in the cloud as a covenant sign
events_in_stated_order.kjv: I do set my bow in the cloud, and it shall be for a token of a covenant between me and the earth.

title: Put these events in order: The Final Week
hint: The first event is in Matthew 21.

events_in_stated_order.event: Crowds cry Hosanna as Jesus enters Jerusalem
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And the multitudes that went before, and that followed, cried, saying, Hosanna to the Son of David: Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord; Hosanna in the highest.

events_in_stated_order.event: Jesus breaks bread at the Last Supper
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And as they were eating, Jesus took bread, and blessed it, and brake it, and gave it to the disciples, and said, Take, eat; this is my body.

events_in_stated_order.event: Jesus prays in Gethsemane
events_in_stated_order.kjv: Then cometh Jesus with them unto a place called Gethsemane, and saith unto the disciples, Sit ye here, while I go and pray yonder.

events_in_stated_order.event: Jesus is crucified
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And they crucified him, and parted his garments, casting lots: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, They parted my garments among them, and upon my vesture did they cast lots.

events_in_stated_order.event: The angel says: He is not here, for he is risen
events_in_stated_order.kjv: He is not here: for he is risen, as he said. Come, see the place where the Lord lay.

title: Put these events in order: Paul's Journeys
hint: The first event is in Acts 9.

events_in_stated_order.event: Saul is converted near Damascus
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And as he journeyed, he came near Damascus: and suddenly there shined round about him a light from heaven:

events_in_stated_order.event: Barnabas and Saul are separated for the work
events_in_stated_order.kjv: As they ministered to the Lord, and fasted, the Holy Ghost said, Separate me Barnabas and Saul for the work whereunto I have called them.

events_in_stated_order.event: Paul sees a vision of a man of Macedonia
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And a vision appeared to Paul in the night; There stood a man of Macedonia, and prayed him, saying, Come over into Macedonia, and help us.

events_in_stated_order.event: Paul preaches on Mars' hill in Athens
events_in_stated_order.kjv: Then Paul stood in the midst of Mars’ hill, and said, Ye men of Athens, I perceive that in all things ye are too superstitious.

events_in_stated_order.event: Paul is shipwrecked on Melita
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And when they were escaped, then they knew that the island was called Melita.

title: Put these events in order: The Plagues on Egypt
hint: The first event is in Exodus 7.

events_in_stated_order.event: Waters turned to blood
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And Moses and Aaron did so, as the LORD commanded; and he lifted up the rod, and smote the waters that were in the river, in the sight of Pharaoh, and in the sight of his servants; and all the waters that were in the river were turned to blood.

events_in_stated_order.event: Frogs cover the land
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And Aaron stretched out his hand over the waters of Egypt; and the frogs came up, and covered the land of Egypt.

events_in_stated_order.event: Dust becomes lice
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And they did so; for Aaron stretched out his hand with his rod, and smote the dust of the earth, and it became lice in man, and in beast; all the dust of the land became lice throughout all the land of Egypt.

events_in_stated_order.event: Thick darkness for three days
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And Moses stretched forth his hand toward heaven; and there was a thick darkness in all the land of Egypt three days:

events_in_stated_order.event: Death of the firstborn
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And it came to pass, that at midnight the LORD smote all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, from the firstborn of Pharaoh that sat on his throne unto the firstborn of the captive that was in the dungeon; and all the firstborn of cattle.

title: Put these events in order: The Prodigal Son
hint: The first event is in Luke 15.

events_in_stated_order.event: The younger son asks for his portion
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And the younger of them said to his father, Father, give me the portion of goods that falleth to me. And he divided unto them his living.

events_in_stated_order.event: He wastes his substance with riotous living
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And not many days after the younger son gathered all together, and took his journey into a far country, and there wasted his substance with riotous living.

events_in_stated_order.event: He feeds swine in a far country
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And he went and joined himself to a citizen of that country; and he sent him into his fields to feed swine.

events_in_stated_order.event: His father runs to embrace him
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And he arose, and came to his father. But when he was yet a great way off, his father saw him, and had compassion, and ran, and fell on his neck, and kissed him.

events_in_stated_order.event: The elder brother is angry
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And he was angry, and would not go in: therefore came his father out, and intreated him.

title: Put these events in order: From the Tomb to the Ascension
hint: The first event is in Luke 24.

events_in_stated_order.event: The women find the stone rolled away
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And they found the stone rolled away from the sepulchre. And they entered in, and found not the body of the Lord Jesus.

events_in_stated_order.event: Two disciples walk to Emmaus
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And, behold, two of them went that same day to a village called Emmaus, which was from Jerusalem about threescore furlongs.

events_in_stated_order.event: Jesus stands among the disciples: Peace be unto you
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And as they thus spake, Jesus himself stood in the midst of them, and saith unto them, Peace be unto you.

events_in_stated_order.event: Jesus is carried up into heaven
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And it came to pass, while he blessed them, he was parted from them, and carried up into heaven.

title: Put these events in order: Ruth's Faithfulness
hint: The first event is in Ruth 1.

events_in_stated_order.event: Ruth vows to go with Naomi
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And Ruth said, Intreat me not to leave thee, or to return from following after thee: for whither thou goest, I will go; and where thou lodgest, I will lodge: thy people shall be my people, and thy God my God:

events_in_stated_order.event: Ruth gleans in the field of Boaz
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And she went, and came, and gleaned in the field after the reapers: and her hap was to light on a part of the field belonging unto Boaz, who was of the kindred of Elimelech.

events_in_stated_order.event: Ruth asks Boaz to spread his skirt over her
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And he said, Who art thou? And she answered, I am Ruth thine handmaid: spread therefore thy skirt over thine handmaid; for thou art a near kinsman.

events_in_stated_order.event: Boaz marries Ruth
events_in_stated_order.kjv: So Boaz took Ruth, and she was his wife: and when he went in unto her, the LORD gave her conception, and she bare a son.

events_in_stated_order.event: Obed is born
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And the women her neighbours gave it a name, saying, There is a son born to Naomi; and they called his name Obed: he is the father of Jesse, the father of David.

title: Put these events in order: The Good Samaritan
hint: The first event is in Luke 10.

events_in_stated_order.event: A traveller falls among thieves
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And Jesus answering said, A certain man went down from Jerusalem to Jericho, and fell among thieves, which stripped him of his raiment, and wounded him, and departed, leaving him half dead.

events_in_stated_order.event: A priest passes by
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And by chance there came down a certain priest that way: and when he saw him, he passed by on the other side.

events_in_stated_order.event: A Levite passes by
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And likewise a Levite, when he was at the place, came and looked on him, and passed by on the other side.

events_in_stated_order.event: A Samaritan binds up his wounds
events_in_stated_order.kjv: But a certain Samaritan, as he journeyed, came where he was: and when he saw him, he had compassion on him, And went to him, and bound up his wounds, pouring in oil and wine, and set him on his own beast, and brought him to an inn, and took care of him.

events_in_stated_order.event: He pays the host two pence
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And on the morrow when he departed, he took out two pence, and gave them to the host, and said unto him, Take care of him; and whatsoever thou spendest more, when I come again, I will repay thee.

title: Put these events in order: The Story of Samson
hint: The first event is in Judges 13.

events_in_stated_order.event: An angel announces a Nazarite son
events_in_stated_order.kjv: For, lo, thou shalt conceive, and bear a son; and no razor shall come on his head: for the child shall be a Nazarite unto God from the womb: and he shall begin to deliver Israel out of the hand of the Philistines.

events_in_stated_order.event: Samson tears a young lion
events_in_stated_order.kjv: Then went Samson down, and his father and his mother, to Timnath, and came to the vineyards of Timnath: and, behold, a young lion roared against him. And the Spirit of the LORD came mightily upon him, and he rent him as he would have rent a kid, and he had nothing in his hand: but he told not his father or his mother what he had done.

events_in_stated_order.event: Samson loves Delilah
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And it came to pass afterward, that he loved a woman in the valley of Sorek, whose name was Delilah.

events_in_stated_order.event: Samson brings down the house
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And Samson said, Let me die with the Philistines. And he bowed himself with all his might; and the house fell upon the lords, and upon all the people that were therein. So the dead which he slew at his death were more than they which he slew in his life.

title: Put these events in order: Samuel the Prophet
hint: The first event is in 1 Samuel 1.

events_in_stated_order.event: Hannah prays and makes a vow
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And she was in bitterness of soul, and prayed unto the LORD, and wept sore. And she vowed a vow, and said, O LORD of hosts, if thou wilt indeed look on the affliction of thine handmaid, and remember me, and not forget thine handmaid, but wilt give unto thine handmaid a man child, then I will give him unto the LORD all the days of his life, and there shall no razor come upon his head.

events_in_stated_order.event: The LORD calls the boy Samuel
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And the LORD came, and stood, and called as at other times, Samuel, Samuel. Then Samuel answered, Speak; for thy servant heareth.

events_in_stated_order.event: Samuel anoints Saul
events_in_stated_order.kjv: Then Samuel took a vial of oil, and poured it upon his head, and kissed him, and said, Is it not because the LORD hath anointed thee to be captain over his inheritance?

events_in_stated_order.event: Samuel anoints David
events_in_stated_order.kjv: Then Samuel took the horn of oil, and anointed him in the midst of his brethren: and the Spirit of the LORD came upon David from that day forward. So Samuel rose up, and went to Ramah.

title: Put these events in order: Solomon's Reign
hint: The first event is in 1 Kings 3.

events_in_stated_order.event: Solomon asks for an understanding heart
events_in_stated_order.kjv: Give therefore thy servant an understanding heart to judge thy people, that I may discern between good and bad: for who is able to judge this thy so great a people?

events_in_stated_order.event: Solomon judges between two mothers
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And the king said, Divide the living child in two, and give half to the one, and half to the other.

events_in_stated_order.event: Solomon builds the house of the LORD
events_in_stated_order.kjv: So Solomon built the house, and finished it.

events_in_stated_order.event: The temple is dedicated
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And Solomon offered a sacrifice of peace offerings, which he offered unto the LORD, two and twenty thousand oxen, and an hundred and twenty thousand sheep. So the king and all the children of Israel dedicated the house of the LORD.

events_in_stated_order.event: The queen of Sheba visits
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And when the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon concerning the name of the LORD, she came to prove him with hard questions.

title: Put these events in order: Wilderness Wanderings
hint: The first event is in Exodus 16.

events_in_stated_order.event: God provides manna
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And when the children of Israel saw it, they said one to another, It is manna: for they wist not what it was. And Moses said unto them, This is the bread which the LORD hath given you to eat.

events_in_stated_order.event: The Ten Commandments are given at Sinai
events_in_stated_order.kjv: Thou shalt have no other gods before me.

events_in_stated_order.event: The people make a golden calf
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And he received them at their hand, and fashioned it with a graving tool, after he had made it a molten calf: and they said, These be thy gods, O Israel, which brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.

events_in_stated_order.event: Twelve spies are sent to search Canaan
events_in_stated_order.kjv: Send thou men, that they may search the land of Canaan, which I give unto the children of Israel: of every tribe of their fathers shall ye send a man, every one a ruler among them.
